instruction: Enable automatic screen brightness adjustment in Ubuntu's power settings.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling automatic brightness in Ubuntu power settings. The config disables it first (sets to false), and the evaluator checks that the agent changed it to true. Uses standard GNOME power settings schema.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_vm_command_line) correctly executes gsettings command to read ambient-enabled setting - extracts exactly the right state for verification
Metric (exact_match) correctly performs strict equality comparison between result and expected value - appropriate for boolean setting verification
Expected value 'true\n' is semantically correct - properly includes newline from gsettings output format
Evaluator verifies the exact requirement: ambient-enabled setting must be true after agent completes the task
Complete coverage - single requirement (enable automatic brightness adjustment) is fully verified with no missing aspects
Logic flow is sound and complete: config disables (false) → agent enables (true) → evaluator verifies enabled state
No state timing issues - gsettings changes are persistent and immediately readable via CLI
No UI dependency - verification reads system setting via CLI (gsettings), not UI state, so postconfig window closing doesn't affect verification
Rule validation warning about UI dependency is a false positive - task uses gsettings (CLI-based) not UI state extraction
